record_origin: Consolidates the completed source, receipt, screenshot and read-only hash/inventory inspection retained in the review conversation. This file was recorded during packaging; the checks and browser run were not replayed.
independence: The AdGuard implementation/evidence lane reviewed these artifacts separately from the uBO Lite implementation and browser-supplement author. No new agent, test, browser, installation or remote operation was used for this review.
method: Read the completed receipts, executed harness source and relevant production/test source; visually inspect the two read-error screenshots; aggregate existing JSON/TAP/lint outcomes; compare SHA-256 values, retained directory inventories and pinned Git object text without running verification again.
hash_semantics: reviewed_artifacts identifies the original raw task artifacts, not the public projections. Paths are task-relative. The package inventory separately binds public-file hashes.

reviewed_artifacts.coverage: Focused results are retained in the lint receipt.

browser_outcomes.claim_interpretation: The raw receipt uses status passed for baseline expectations. api_boundaries.boundary: Playwright-driven native filechooser event and native FileReader read. The actual fixture extension service worker handles settings messages; autoReload is observed through getCurrentConfig. This is not a test of persistence after a browser restart.
FileChooser.setFiles([]), not a visible operating-system file-dialog cancellation click.
A FileReader subclass injects NotReadableError and error/loadend events without a native read.
A FileReader subclass throws an injected SecurityError before calling the native read.
The subclass starts native readAsText and calls native abort(). The patched receipt records Chromium's AbortError as handled.
Only the extension page's chrome.storage.local.remove is replaced for userDnrRules. Other calls use the real runtime. Earlier autoReload changes are already visible; recovery is not rollback.
Native confirm events accepted/dismissed through Playwright. A new page is used per case and autoReload is seeded per case; a fresh profile is used per variant.

lint_and_host_evidence.host_boundary: The existing jsdom suite executes actual settings, restore and DOM modules with simulated WebExtension runtime/storage and injected file/module failures. Dynamic module-load rejection and repeat-use after failure are covered there, not by the Chromium supplement.
